name: predict2improve
summary: Code for Carson, Ford and Milford's RA-L 2022 paper on predicting per-frame visual localization integrity. A Jupyter notebook runs the predictor on precomputed Nordland features.
why_it_matters: A ready per-frame VPR success predictor; a fix scheduler can reuse the idea to estimate success probability before paying for fine matching. MIT license.
hackathon_notes: README only: run `jupyter lab example.ipynb` with the linked Nordland feature set. Last push 2022-10. Retrain on VPAIR retrieval scores rather than reusing the Nordland model; not run here.

name: gf_orb_slam2 (Good Feature / Good Graph)
summary: ORB-SLAM2 fork from Georgia Tech IVALab with good-feature selection and the budget-aware Good Graph local bundle adjustment.
why_it_matters: Reference code for anticipating estimation needs and capping compute per step in visual SLAM. GPL-3.0 (inherited from ORB-SLAM2; GitHub reports NOASSERTION, LICENSE.txt points to License-gpl.txt), so not for a closed product.
hackathon_notes: Heavy ORB-SLAM2-era build; not run here. Read for the budget logic only.
